name: PSYCHO-PASS サイコパス 新編集版
original_name: PSYCHO-PASS サイコパス 新編集版
overview: Re-edited broadcast of the original Psycho-Pass series. The 22 episodes of season 1 were condensed into 11 extended episodes of approximately 45 minutes each, with new scenes added and enhanced visual effects, especially of the Dominator weapon system.
